findings.importantDetails: Workforce, inputs, finance and risk symbols recur symmetrically and visually ground a common conditional comparison. These cues support the new criteria/mechanisms/conditions/limits wording without serving as task solutions.

findings.desktop680: Both scenes and the paired criteria symbols remain clear at actual680x382.703125, below the448heightcap; no crop.

findings.mainIdea: A shopper visibly compares two unbranded backpacks; large budget, practical-use and peers thought bubbles make multiple motives distinguishable.
findings.importantDetails: Budget and use needs constrain/shape the comparison; social context is a legitimate additional influence. No numerical price, universal utility ranking or diagnosis of irrationality is claimed. Available-information analysis belongs to the textual goal/P cases; an orientation image does not need to depict every assessment step.
